name: Sports Specific Conditioning
description: Designs conditioning programs tailored to the physical demands of common recreational sports including tennis, basketball, soccer, and swimming. Analyzes energy system requirements, movement patterns, and sport-specific fitness qualities to produce a structured off-court or off-field conditioning plan. Use when the user asks about getting in shape for a specific sport, sport-specific conditioning, improving athletic performance for recreational sports, or pre-season training for a sport. Do NOT use for professional or elite-level athletic programming, injury rehabilitation, general strength training (use beginner-strength-training), or running-specific plans (use running-training-plan).
